acceptance_criteria.evidence:
webapp/src/components/LandingPage.tsx exists. Renders

Mnemonic Protocol

, protocol description (3 paragraphs derived from whitepaper), and . E2E test app.spec.ts + chat.spec.ts verify heading visibility and button click navigation.

tailwind.config.js defines background: '#0A0F1E' and accent-primary: '#00D4B4'. index.css sets body background-color and color via CSS custom properties. Both Tailwind v4 @theme tokens and config file are in sync.

No explicit timeout set on the reqwest client (defaults to no timeout), so Ollama gets as much time as needed. Nginx proxy_read_timeout for /chat is 60s. The 15-second requirement is an expected performance target, not enforced via timeout. The warm-up inference in entrypoint.sh pre-loads the model to avoid cold start latency. Verifiable only on live deployment.

acceptance_criteria.description: Benchmark: 'What are the 5 MCP tools?' returns all five (whoami, sign_memory, verify, prove_identity, recall)
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Testable only with live Ollama + seeded knowledge. Seed.rs parses docs/WHITEPAPER.md by ## sections and signs each chunk. The whitepaper must contain the 5 MCP tools for RAG recall to surface them. Static verification: system prompt instructs 'Answer questions ONLY based on the provided context', recall fetches top-3 chunks. Requires runtime verification with seeded store.

acceptance_criteria.description: Download .zip with .md (YAML frontmatter: content_hash, signer_pubkey, timestamp) + .json
acceptance_criteria.evidence: seed.rs generate_artifact() creates protocol-knowledge.zip with knowledge.md and knowledge.json. Unit test generate_artifact_creates_zip verifies zip contains both files. generate_markdown_produces_yaml_frontmatter test verifies content_hash, signer_pubkey, timestamp in YAML. generate_json_sidecar_has_all_fields test verifies JSON structure. LandingPage.tsx has download link to /download-knowledge. GET /download-knowledge handler serves the zip with correct Content-Type and Content-Disposition headers.

seed.rs run() checks store.count(&pubkey) > 0 at the start and returns Ok(()) with a log message if attestations already exist. Logic is clear in source (lines 173-180). No dedicated unit test for idempotency (noted in test audit as medium gap), but logic is straightforward.

acceptance_criteria.description: Rate limit: 429 on 11th request per minute per IP
acceptance_criteria.evidence: main.rs creates keyed rate limiter with Quota::per_minute(NonZeroU32::new(10)). chat.rs checks state.chat_limiter.check_key(&ip_key) at handler start, returns 429 TOO_MANY_REQUESTS with {error: 'Rate limit exceeded', code: 'rate_limited'}. Governor crate handles the per-IP windowing. Note: behind nginx, all requests share one IP (SEC-06, deferred fix).

acceptance_criteria.description: Session limit: 50 messages client-side, UI blocks input
acceptance_criteria.evidence: ChatPage.tsx defines SESSION_MESSAGE_LIMIT = 50. messageCount state tracks sent messages. isLimitReached = messageCount >= SESSION_MESSAGE_LIMIT. When reached: alert banner 'Session limit reached. Start a new session to continue.' with role='alert', textarea and Send button disabled. E2E test chat.spec.ts sends 50 messages and verifies banner, disabled state, and counter text.

chat.rs returns 503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE with code 'service_unavailable' on both reqwest send failure and non-2xx Ollama response. api.ts maps service_unavailable to 'Service temporarily unavailable. Try again later.' with 3 retry attempts. Handler tests chat_ollama_error_returns_503 and chat_ollama_timeout_returns_503 verify backend behavior. E2E test 'error state: service unavailable' verifies full flow with retry count assertion.

System prompt in chat.rs: 'You are a Mnemonic Protocol expert assistant. Answer questions using ONLY the provided context. If the context does not contain the answer, say so honestly. Do not make up information.' This constrains the LLM to protocol context only. E2E test 'out-of-scope question' covers the UI flow (with mocked response). Actual rejection quality depends on LLM behavior at runtime.

ollama/Dockerfile pre-pulls qwen2.5:3b at build time (multi-stage build). ollama/entrypoint.sh waits up to 30s for Ollama readiness, then issues warm-up inference with num_predict:1. docker-compose.yml sets ollama healthcheck with start_period: 60s, retries: 10. MCP depends_on ollama with condition: service_healthy. Total cold start budget: ~30s Ollama start + ~10s warm-up + ~20s MCP seed = well within 90s.

chat.rs MAX_MESSAGE_LEN = 2000. Validation uses message.chars().count() (Unicode-safe). Returns 400 BAD_REQUEST with 'message exceeds maximum length of 2000 characters'. Handler test chat_message_over_2000_chars_returns_400 sends 2001 chars and asserts 400 + error contains '2000'. Test chat_message_exactly_2000_chars_passes_validation confirms boundary.

acceptance_criteria.description: docker compose up works with 3 services (nginx, MCP, Ollama)
acceptance_criteria.evidence: docker-compose.yml defines exactly 3 services: nginx (nginx:1.27-alpine), mcp (custom Dockerfile), ollama (custom Dockerfile). Dependency chain: ollama -> mcp -> nginx with health checks. Shared bridge network 'mnemonic'. Volumes for data persistence. Environment variables configured.

acceptance_criteria.description: Playwright E2E: open -> Start chat -> send question -> receive answer -> download artifact
acceptance_criteria.evidence: webapp/e2e/chat.spec.ts 'golden path' test covers the full flow: goto('/'), verify heading, verify download link (href + download attribute + actual download event), click 'Start chat', verify chat heading, send question, verify user message + bot answer in role='log', verify counter 1/50. Additional tests cover out-of-scope, session limit, error states, and back navigation.
